APT coordinates three agents to construct evaluation sets from user requirements, diagnose model-specific strengths and failure modes, and generate reinforcement learning data with an adaptive prompt distribution that emphasizes underperforming capabilities. By repeatedly evaluating, diagnosing, and updating the generator, APT lets the current model's behavior shape its next training tasks, forming a feedback loop inspired by recursive self-improvement. For general-purpose settings without user-specified evaluation scenarios, we further develop an evaluation harness that enables broad and diverse evaluation set generation. Experiments across multiple base models, benchmarks, and generation architectures demonstrate that APT is model-agnostic, benchmark-agnostic, architecture-agnostic, and fully automated.

papers.title_en: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
papers.authors: Tianjiao Yu, Zhilin Ou, Yifan Shen, Xinzhuo Li, Yuanzhe Liu, Onkar Kishor Susladkar, Fan Wang, Ismini Lourentzou
papers.evidence: 数据引擎与策略协同演化以自动生成有用训练环境
papers.tldr: 生成式仿真能自动构建机器人环境，但物理有效并不等于对训练有用。CoDA让数据引擎与动作策略通过异构记忆协同演化，把视觉语言批评器验证的诊断转成环境生成程序与训练程序，并用Text2potential构造分阶段势函数提供密集监督。在四类操作任务中，OOD成功率从监督微调后的5.3%升至27.6%，比最强闭环基线高9.5个百分点；LIBERO-Pro上位置扰动25%→84%、指令扰动1%→76%。
papers.abstract_en: Generative simulation can automate robot environment construction, but physically valid environments are not necessarily useful for training. The challenge is to identify environments that address a policy's failures and supervision that helps it overcome them. We introduce CoDA, a framework in which a simulation data engine and an action policy co-evolve through a shared heterogeneous memory of environment construction, policy failures, and learning progress. The memory compiles validated diagnoses from a vision-language critic into generation programs that recreate difficulties and training programs that help the policy overcome them. We further propose Text2potential to convert these diagnoses into staged potentials for action-chunk value learning, providing dense supervision for policy updates while preserving the task's optimal policy under standard shaping assumptions. Measured learning progress guides further generation and program refinement. Across four manipulation task families, CoDA improves out-of-distribution success from 5.3% after supervised fine-tuning to 27.6%, exceeding the strongest closed-loop baseline by 9.5 percentage points with the same generation budget. On LIBERO-Pro, 15 rounds of generation and training raise success from 25% to 84% under position perturbations and from 1% to 76% under instruction perturbations.

papers.title_en: Capability-Driven Self-Evolution of Agent Memory
papers.authors: Yaoqi Chen, Yuru Feng, Qianxi Zhang, Baotong Lu, Jianan Lu, Zhirui Wang, Shusen Xu, Zewen Jin, Zengzhong Li, Cheng Li, Qi Chen
papers.evidence: 基于任务反馈的智能体记忆自演化
papers.tldr: 现有智能体记忆自进化多采用整体式优化，混合反馈易掩盖能力特定收益，限制探索方向。PrisMem将搜索引导扩展到单项能力维度，结合依赖感知的能力选择、历史引导诊断与轨迹引导集成，合并互补改进。在BEAM-1M和LongMemEval-M上分别超过最强基线10.54和7.83个百分点。该工作表明能力驱动进化可提升百万token历史下的记忆程序优化效果。
papers.abstract_en: Memory self-evolution uses task feedback to iteratively improve executable memory programs that store and retrieve information from past interactions. Existing approaches typically adopt holistic evolution, deriving revision directions from mixed feedback and judging progress by overall performance. This can obscure optimization directions and hide capability-specific gains offset by regressions elsewhere, leaving promising directions underexplored. We introduce capability-driven evolution, which extends search guidance from overall performance to individual capability dimensions, preserving promising revisions and expanding exploration beyond the boundaries of holistic evolution. We propose PrisMem, which uses dependency-aware capability selection to prioritize targets with potential cross-capability benefits and history-guided diagnosis to refine capability specialists. Trace-guided integration compares evaluated programs on paired differential cases, using their behavioral differences to consolidate complementary gains into a unified memory program. Experiments show that PrisMem outperforms the strongest baselines by 10.54 and 7.83 percentage points on BEAM-1M and LongMemEval-M, respectively, demonstrating its effectiveness on million-token histories.

papers.title_en: From Intelligence to Autonomy: Foundations and Construction of Autonomous Agents for Future Intelligent Systems
papers.authors: Hongda Zhang, Ziqing Zhou, Yuning Chen, Linqiang Hu, Yi Liu, Ding Zhou, Zhao Huang, Haining Xu
papers.evidence: 自主智能体通过反馈调整长期能力
papers.tldr: AI正从单次感知生成走向长期规划与环境交互，但任务能力不等于自主性，仍需外部设定目标、维持运行与批准更新。作者界定自主智能体须在身份与权限边界内同时维持任务目标和存续条件，并基于世界与自模型持续行动、通过反馈调整控制与长期能力。方法上梳理稳态反馈到生物自主性的脉络及六条操作化路线，提出单边界四环框架：操作、存续、反思与学习。五项配对仿真初步验证权限约束、封路响应、健康维护、能力重估和跨任务学习的可行性，更广环境与物理系统仍待测试。
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence is moving from one-off perception and generation tasks toward long-term planning, tool use, and interaction with real environments. Greater task competence, however, does not automatically yield autonomy: an external actor may still have to set goals, sustain operating conditions, detect failures, and approve updates. We define an autonomous agent as a system that, within explicit identity and authority boundaries, maintains both task goals and viability conditions, acts continuously using models of the world and itself, and adjusts its control mechanisms and long-term capabilities through feedback. We trace the conceptual path from homeostasis and feedback control to autopoiesis and biological autonomy. We then distinguish six lines of operationalization: computational autopoiesis, behavior-based robotics, agent formalization, adaptive software, embodied adaptation, and robotic self-modeling. On this basis, we propose a one-boundary, four-loop framework in which Operational, Viability, Reflexive, and Learning loops organize task execution, self-maintenance, metacontrol, and governed learning. Five paired simulation experiments test permission constraints, road-closure response, health maintenance, capability re-estimation, and cross-task learning. Their results provide preliminary evidence for the feasibility of these mechanisms, while broader environments and physical systems remain to be tested.
